Property guidance · Visakhapatnam

About Ram Realty

Ram Realty is a property consultancy and listing website for people exploring homes in Visakhapatnam. It brings together selected owner-share listings in Madhurawada and nearby areas, with project details and enquiry options in one place.

Property consultant Ramsai Seera is the contact identified by Ram Realty for enquiries. The properties shown are owner-share listings; the pages present listing details and enquiry support, not a claim that Ram Realty or Ramsai Seera owns the homes. Visitors can ask for current availability and connect with the relevant property contact to arrange a conversation or visit.

A clear, practical approach

  • Explore property pages for the details currently published on this website.
  • Ask Ram Realty to confirm the specific unit, current availability, project status, area details and complete written cost before making a decision.
  • Review official project documents and independently verify approvals, RERA information, terms and builder details where applicable.
  • Arrange a callback or site visit through the enquiry form, phone or WhatsApp.

Local areas covered

Current listings and property information focus on Madhurawada, Sai Priya Layout, PM Palem, Yendada, Kommadi and nearby parts of Visakhapatnam. Availability changes, so contact Ram Realty for the latest information rather than relying on an older price or listing.
